title: Remove or assert the print-only status matrix in the long-child regression
outcome: The long-child regression performs only useful verification reads and preserves independently discriminating clean, dirty, untracked, configuration and zero-exit-error coverage.
acceptance: Remove the original print-only root/child false/true matrix or give it meaningful assertions; keep the independently asserted different-size matrix and original clean/dirty/untracked/config immutability witnesses.
